submission.title: SYNTHETIC: Water balance in semi-arid basins

matches.text: This assignment must be submitted through the virtual campus before the published deadline
evapotranspiration accounts for most of the water leaving the basin
rainfall arrives in a few intense events each year
Groundwater recharge happens mostly in wet years, when soils are saturated for several weeks
In an earlier essay I described how small check dams slow runoff and let water soak into the riverbed during the brief floods of late summer
Smith, J. (2020). Groundwater recharge in semi-arid regions. Journal of Synthetic Hydrology, 12(3), 45-67.
record rainfall, soil moisture and river level every fifteen minutes
